rust.ociPosture: Nix may validate or build a candidate service image only after parity with the repository's existing runtime contract is proven. Libraries are not long-running OCI workloads.

flutter.ociPosture: Mobile applications are not OCI runtime workloads. A web artifact image belongs in its serving or deployment repository and needs an independent runtime review.

node.ociPosture: Preserve an existing non-root, digest-pinned Node image until startup, signal, health, CA, package-manager, and supply-chain parity is demonstrated.

go.ociPosture: A Nix-built Go image is a candidate until non-root execution, certificates, ports, entrypoint, signals, health checks, size, provenance, and deployment parity are proven.

python.ociPosture: Do not replace a working Python runtime image until dependency resolution, native wheels, non-root behavior, certificates, entrypoint, signals, health, and supply-chain evidence match.

kubernetes.ociPosture: Infrastructure repositories usually validate and deploy images rather than define one universal OCI output. Repository-specific render, policy, and deployment checks are mandatory.

polyglot.ociPosture: A monorepo must keep service-specific OCI contracts. Never promote one generic Nix image across unrelated applications.
